mapper.sql: select id, outbound_no, rela_ent_nm, busi_type, busi_form_num, rela_customs_form_type, rela_customs_form_num, calculating_record_no, batch_no, in_out_time, doc_status, customs_status, execute_type, last_uuid, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time from br_outbound
mapper.select: select max(outbound_no) from br_outbound where outbound_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into br_outbound (outbound_no, rela_ent_nm, busi_type, busi_form_num, rela_customs_form_type, rela_customs_form_num, calculating_record_no, batch_no, in_out_time, doc_status, customs_status, execute_type, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{outboundNo}, #{relaEntNm}, #{busiType}, #{busiFormNum}, #{relaCustomsFormType}, #{relaCustomsFormNum}, #{calculatingRecordNo}, #{batchNo}, #{inOutTime}, '01', '00', '1', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update br_outbound set update_time = sysdate(), last_uuid = #{uuid}, doc_status = #{docStatus}, customs_status = #{customsStatus}, execute_type = #{executeType} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: update br_outbound set del_flag = '2' where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select t.*, m.material_name, m.material_cd, m.version, m.calc_unit, m.is_bonded, m.g_model, m.mark_type from br_outbound_item t left join br_material m on m.id = t.material_id where t.outbound_id = #{outboundId}
mapper.insert: insert into br_outbound_item (outbound_id, material_id, delivery_cnt, price, currency, specifications_models, goods_source_type, goods_source_no, busi_desc) values (#{outboundId}, #{materialId}, #{deliveryCnt}, #{price}, #{currency}, #{specificationsModels}, #{goodsSourceType}, #{goodsSourceNo}, #{busiDesc})
